title: P2.16 Resolve and verify the action-installed pnpm runner
description: Measured at dd2a833: release supply-chain code hard-codes node-adjacent node_modules/corepack/dist/pnpm.js, absent in the pnpm/action-setup GitHub runner layout. Resolve the actual action-installed pnpm entrypoint using host-aware executable discovery, verify its target/version, and invoke it without an unsafe shell.
definitionOfDone: A Linux runner-layout test with pnpm outside the Node installation resolves and executes the intended action-installed pnpm.
Windows shim, POSIX executable, symlink, missing target, foreign target, and version mismatch cases have deterministic verified/refused outcomes.
Invocation uses shell:false and safe argv; if a shim resolves to a JS entrypoint, Node executes the verified target explicitly.
Failure reports the exact supply-chain reason code without leaking environment or credentials.
Release supply-chain tests run standalone with nonzero counts on supported hosts.
taskRails: Do not assume Corepack is beside node.
Do not fall back to shell command strings or an unverified PATH hit.
Pin/verify the expected pnpm version from repository authority.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red: in a new `action-installed pnpm runner` describe block, add at least 12 named production-surface cases using bounded temporary action layouts and injected host/process seams only (do not reimplement the resolver). Prove an action-style Linux/POSIX layout outside the Node installation and a Windows `.cmd` layout both resolve to the installed `pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs`; cover a regular POSIX executable, an internally contained symlink, missing PNPM_HOME/shim/manifest/target, an external or cross-volume symlink/target, foreign package name, repository pin versus installed-version mismatch, and bin-map traversal/drift. The execution spy must receive exactly `process.execPath`, `[verifiedEntry, ...callerArgs]`, the caller cwd, existing timeout/maxBuffer/windowsHide bounds, and explicit `shell:false`; no shim or shell command may run. Every refusal asserts the exact object `RELEASE_SUPPLY_CHAIN_REFUSED` / `TOOLCHAIN_OBSERVATION_FAILED` / `RELEASE_SUPPLY_CHAIN`, exact key set, and absence of fixture paths, env values, credentials, raw child errors, stdout, and stderr. Add a literal expected-case count plus `executedCases > 0`, and pin that `typecheck:release` names the new module and supply-chain imports it with no node-adjacent Corepack or bare pnpm fallback. Run the focused name-filter command before implementation and retain the named red output; the current one-file wrapper pass is explicitly not a red or pass.

implementationPlan.description: Implement the minimum verified runner. Create `scripts/release/pnpm-runner.mjs` (target <=250 lines) with a small exported resolver/executor seam that derives the action destination only from PNPM_HOME ending in `node_modules/.bin`, reads the caller repository/package root as version authority, requires exact agreement between root `packageManager` and `engines.pnpm`, and validates the installed manifest's `name`, `version`, and `bin.pnpm` mapping. Require the host-appropriate action shim to exist but never execute it; realpath and contain the package root and JS entry under the action destination, require a regular target (allowing only contained symlink resolution), and repeat the identity/containment check immediately before spawn. Resolution/identity failures return only `releaseRefusal('TOOLCHAIN_OBSERVATION_FAILED')`. Execute the verified `.cjs` through `execFile(process.execPath, [entry, ...args], {cwd, encoding:'utf8', maxBuffer:16 MiB, timeout:180000, windowsHide:true, shell:false})`; preserve bounded command-result handling so later install failures still map to `FROZEN_INSTALL_FAILED`. In `supply-chain.mjs`, remove PNPM_ENTRY/node-adjacent Corepack logic, delegate all three pnpm call sites plus observation to the helper, and translate a helper refusal to a sanitized failed command result so `runReleaseSupplyChain` remains the owning layer for `TOOLCHAIN_OBSERVATION_FAILED`; do not change other release codes. Add the new JS module to the explicit `typecheck:release` file list in package.json. Run the focused runner suite to green with at least 12 named passes and the literal nonzero matrix assertion.
